current_state_markdown: On `main`, `.bosatsu_version` pins the repo-local wrapper to Bosatsu 0.0.67. The sole active `core_alpha` dependency declaration is `public_deps.core_alpha` in `src/zafu_conf.json`, which pins version 8.0.2 to the artifact published with Bosatsu 0.0.67. The generic launcher and benchmark tooling already read `.bosatsu_version`, so they do not contain a second active compiler version pin. Historical benchmark results and earlier code plans contain older version metadata but are not dependency configuration.
problem_markdown: Issue #214 requests the update to Bosatsu 0.0.68 and explicitly requires bumping the core alpha library. The Bosatsu 0.0.68 release publishes `core_alpha` 9.0.0, but the repository still selects the 0.0.67 compiler/runtime and `core_alpha` 8.0.2 artifact. The two active pins must move together so dependency fetching, checking, testing, and publishing use a consistent release.

steps.description_markdown: Change `.bosatsu_version` from `0.0.67` to `0.0.68`. In `src/zafu_conf.json`, update only `public_deps.core_alpha`: set `version` to `9.0.0`, set its sole hash to `blake3:a8abc327ee53c5aa057c94be53cb357ff120563b196f2d65461400cd5c3f1f3d`, and set its sole URI to `https://github.com/johnynek/bosatsu/releases/download/v0.0.68/core_alpha-v9.0.0.bosatsu_lib`. Leave `exported_packages`, `all_packages`, repository metadata, `bosatsu_libs.json`, historical benchmark results, generated planning artifacts, and generic launcher/benchmark code unchanged. Use `./bosatsu --fetch` and `./bosatsu fetch` to exercise the new release and dependency metadata, then run `./bosatsu check --warn` and `./bosatsu test --warn` as focused compatibility checks. Do not make speculative source changes; if the new compiler or library exposes a concrete incompatibility, apply only the smallest source/test correction needed to preserve existing behavior and public APIs, with focused regression coverage for any behavior change.
invariants: The repo-local wrapper resolves Bosatsu release 0.0.68 through the existing `.bosatsu_version` mechanism.
The `core_alpha` version, Blake3 hash, and download URI identify the same `core_alpha` 9.0.0 artifact published with Bosatsu 0.0.68.
The bounded active-pin inventory remains `.bosatsu_version` and `src/zafu_conf.json`; historical version records and consumers that already resolve `.bosatsu_version` are not rewritten.
Zafu’s exported packages, package discovery settings, repository metadata, and existing behavior remain unchanged unless a concrete 0.0.68 compatibility failure requires a minimal correction.
